note: Preconditions/effects are the demonstrated five-field strings; executor must ground them.

steps.instruction: pick up the upper small round part
steps.target: upper small round part (type uncertain, possibly nut)
preconditions: two small round parts resting on teal surface to right of metal plate with two studs, gripper open and away
effects: gripper grasped small round part and lifted from surface - seating/ grasp verified by part no longer on surface, secure hold unverified

steps.instruction: insert the small round part into the upper stud on rectangular metal plate
steps.target: upper stud on rectangular metal plate
preconditions: gripper holding small round part above surface, upper stud of metal plate exposed
effects: small round part appears positioned over/on upper stud of metal plate, final seating/tightening unverified due to occlusion and low resolution

steps.instruction: pick up the remaining small round part
steps.target: remaining small round part (type uncertain, possibly nut) on surface
preconditions: one small round part remaining on teal surface to right of plate, one part possibly on upper stud (uncertain), gripper moved away from plate
effects: gripper grasped second small round part and lifted from surface, secure hold unverified

steps.instruction: insert the small round part into the lower stud on rectangular metal plate
steps.target: lower stud on rectangular metal plate
preconditions: gripper holding second small round part above surface, lower stud of metal plate exposed
effects: small round part appears positioned over/on lower stud of metal plate, final seating/tightening unverified due to occlusion and low resolution
